summary: This March 2025 Church and Empire lecture is already-public Taboo support for scapegoating and crusading, while adding bounded pressure for Religion As Administrative Filter and Bureaucracy: the church commands soul, afterlife, orthodoxy, sacrament, office, and record-keeping before later reform pressure appears.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: nobles can let peasants kill Jews now and then as a ritual sacrifice that cleanses anger.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Taboo page already cites this source for scapegoating as social-pressure routing: accumulated resentment is moved into a marked body so the larger order can feel cleansed or unified.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: the church's recurring toolkit is scapegoating, persecuting, and crusading.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is the same mechanism as the existing Taboo anchor: church legitimacy trouble is routed through vulnerable or external targets rather than back into the institutional contradiction that produced the pressure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the church-history layer for scapegoating, persecution, crusading, and sacred violence as purification. The page already uses this source for class resentment routed through Jewish middlemen, crusading as social-pressure redirection, and later ritual sacrifice language.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns the source when the active mechanism is displaced guilt, marked bodies, sacred violence, and purification. Religion As Administrative Filter owns office-centered interpretation and orthodoxy; Bureaucracy owns institutional afterlife and record procedure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as bounded future evidence if Administrative Filter needs the medieval Catholic monopoly layer: Latin, authorized priests, sacraments, right thinking, excommunication, and orthodoxy make access to salvation pass through office-centered interpretation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Administrative Filter owns this only where the question is who may interpret, teach, absolve, excommunicate, or administer salvation. Free Will owns the soul's agency loss; Eschatology owns final-order role scripts; Taboo owns scapegoat and sacrificial routing.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Inquisition and late-church record-keeping material as future bureaucracy evidence: the institution improves its control form by moving from crusade and mob violence toward pen, procedure, records, evidence extraction, and repeatable investigation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Bureaucracy owns the procedural afterlife of religious authority when offices, records, evidentiary forms, and institutional self-preservation matter more than charismatic crusade energy.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep the Second Coming and Jerusalem battlefield material as eschatology pressure only when a future compression needs crusade motivation as sacred role-script: Jerusalem is not merely territory but a place where end-time expectation, holy war, and new-world order become imaginable.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns sacred role-script and final-order expectation. Strategy or Chokepoint should not absorb this unless a later source turns the Crusades into a material route/access comparison.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as a background church-obedience contrast if Free Will later compresses the Grand Inquisitor and Dante anti-obedience layers: the church can offer salvation by translating fear of hell and desire for forgiveness into obedience to the institution.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns agency capture when obedience replaces the soul's responsibility. Religion As Administrative Filter owns the office code; Taboo owns the purification target; Eschatology owns heaven, hell, and final order.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep only bounded legitimacy pressure: the church repairs contradiction between poverty religion and institutional wealth by making holy war, Jerusalem, salvation, and protection of Christendom narratable as legitimate authority.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction receives only the contradiction-repair layer. It should not become a generic Church, Crusades, or Catholicism page.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-03-20, this lecture sits after the Middle Kingdom and before the Protestant Reformation lecture in the Civilization sequence. It supplies the Catholic monopoly and corruption layer that the March 27 Reformation-capitalism source later treats as mediation, hierarchy, works, and disconnection.

The lecture's crusade sequence runs from Muslim capture of Jerusalem in 638, through Seljuk pressure after 1071, to Urban II's 1095 call and the 1099 capture and massacre of Jerusalem. Preserve those as dated source claims rather than a standalone Crusades page.

Jiang moves from Saladin in 1187 and Templar persecution in 1307 through the Little Ice Age, famine, Black Death, 1378 papal split, Wycliffe, Hus, and Luther; this should feed future Religion/Bureaucracy chronology only if public prose needs that institutional sequence.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Taboo already carries the source's scapegoat mechanism, while Religion As Administrative Filter and Bureaucracy already have broader church/office/procedure homes that can absorb this source later by active mechanism.

Do not create standalone Church and Empire, Catholic Church, Crusades, Inquisition, Orthodoxy, Afterlife Bureaucracy, Jerusalem, Templars, Saladin, Wycliffe, Hus, Luther, or Church That Demanded Your Soul pages from this source alone.

If public synthesis follows, prefer a Religion As Administrative Filter / Bureaucracy comparison review across Godhead, Church and Empire, Reformation, Scientific Revolutions, Holy Roman Empire, and Paradiso Francis-Dominic material before adding ordinary church-control prose.

If provenance work follows, link only exact episode marks for scapegoating, orthodoxy, afterlife monopoly, and Inquisition procedure; avoid generic Church or Crusades backlinks that blur Taboo, Religion, Bureaucracy, Eschatology, and Free Will.
